title: Static full-population candidate coverage for retained private guards
head: 34df07de5f820635cdc8614dd5824c3ae387e5a6

population_proof.primary_saved_geometry_gap_disposition: The initial execution failed closed. The one missing /PROT_VM track was then resolved uniquely from the pinned earlier saved-native local-retention raw, at (86.4,112.2) to (86.4,112.208) mm on F.Cu, width 0.1778 mm.
population_proof.NPTH_policy: The two NPTH circles are retained as physical-hole obstacles, never reported as conductive copper; neither entered the 60 broad-phase pairs.

method.pad_authority: Saved-native global centres, sizes, orientations and layer IDs only; no footprint-local pose transform.
method.layer_expansion: Saved through-pad and via spans were intersected/expanded across the actual four enabled copper layers. No literal '*.Cu' comparison was used.
method.broad_phase: Conservative AABBs enclosing every supported exact primitive on each actual conductive layer.
method.narrow_phase: Exact Euclidean core distance for tracks, vias, circles, ovals, rectangles and roundrects against the unchanged circle/capsule/oriented-rectangle guard shapes and 0.25 mm halo.
method.shape_limit: All population shapes were supported. Any future unsupported or nonorthogonal saved-native pad fails rather than producing a zero/success fallback.
method.self_policy: Each guard's own source object is included in coverage and reported separately as one of 18 explicit protected-object self pairs, not waived.

new_population_controls: all 177 retained copper UUIDs resolved uniquely
wrong opposite-pad poses for R26.1 and C28.1 rejected

comparison_to_prior_46.added_pair_disposition: All 18 are the guard's own protected source object on that guard layer. They are expected actual-copper self contacts and are separated from collateral findings.
comparison_to_prior_46.removed_pair_disposition: All four were old broad-phase false positives caused by placing R26.1 or C28.1 at the opposite private-pad location. They were already exact-clear relationships, not contacts.

foreign_net_minimum.disposition: Unchanged guard-representation conflict. The copper gap exceeds 0.20 mm; this is not a copper-clearance failure and the existing route remains.

attempts.result: Failed closed because retained UUID 898341e7... had no complete geometry in the primary saved-connectivity JSON.
Successful full-population audit after adding the pinned saved-native geometry supplement.
Final-code historical default-mode regression; exact prior raw reproduced.

execution.execution_allowance_status: Three supervised analyzer/test children used; no further execution remains in this bounded item.

root_review.accepted_scope: Conservative coverage of the exact177 retained primitives and97 saved-native fixed pads against the unchanged18 analytic guards, plus the60 actual surviving pair classifications.
root_review.original_gap_closed: Non-private obstacle poses and all-enabled-layer pad/via membership now come from the bound native evidence. No new collateral contact was found; four wrong-pose false positives were removed.
independently_checked: Repository analyzer equals the actually executed snapshot; numeric raw and process receipt hashes match.
The historical-mode regression reproduces the exact earlier corrected raw bytes.
The supplementary missing-track geometry has the same five authoritative source hashes as the primary evidence.
All97 saved pad records have no offset, chamfer, rect_delta or custom-primitive modifiers. Circle widths/heights agree; both NPTH pad extents equal their0.65mm drills.
The60 surviving pairs comprise eight rectangular-pad,39 track and13 via relationships. Rounded-rectangle, oval and circular component pads are excluded by conservative bounds.
All recorded child and supervisor PIDs are absent; no further analyzer execution was performed by root.
root_review.generalization_limit: This is not a generalized new-source geometry-engine qualification. TP10/TP11 use ratio0.5 rounded rectangles: their zero-size cores give valid enclosing bounds here, but degenerate-core narrow-phase handling is not qualified and must be corrected/tested before such a shape can become a nearby candidate. No such shape reaches narrow phase in this exact bound run.
root_review.next_item: Select a native guard representation and exact retained-source intrusion contract for the critical block; do not waive whole nets or automatically generate/upload full-board inputs.

limits: This is static saved-native population and geometry evidence, not native KiCad rule behavior or product keepout approval.
Existing intended-terminal joins and known GND contacts are not reinterpreted.
No product grounding, circuit repair, routing, fabrication, supplier, or child-use acceptance is claimed.
Pre-existing worktree modifications in docs/design-inputs/2026-10-02-quilter-workflow.json and docs/quilter-workflow-study-2026-10-02.md were preserved and not touched by this item.
